description: This file contains functions for parsing and validating Certificate Revocation Lists (CRLs) in the context of X.509 certificates, including parsing CRL structures, checking revocation status, and handling distribution points and extensions.

classes.name: ParsedCrlTbsCertList
classes.description: Structure representing the parsed TBSCertList component of a CRL.

methods.name: ParseCrlCertificateList
methods.description: Parses the raw CRL data into its components: TBSCertList, signature algorithm, and signature value.

methods.name: ParseCrlTbsCertList
methods.description: Parses the TBSCertList part of a CRL, extracting version, issuer, update times, revoked certificates, and extensions.

methods.name: CheckCRL
methods.description: Validates a CRL against a certificate chain, checking signatures, issuer, dates, and revocation status.
